title: Your First Heading
story: Every web page is made of tags. A heading tag gives the page its title.
goal:
Add a main heading:

Welcome to Aata

.
starter:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>My Page</title>
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Add your heading here -->
</body>
</html>

tests.label: There is an h1 on the page

hints:
A tag has an opening part

and a closing part

. The words go between them.
Welcome to Aata
socratic: What are the two parts of a tag?
Open the Preview: do you see your heading?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Your First Heading”?
solution: Welcome to Aata
